title: One spin listens to its neighbors
hook: Two stated cases: explore the conditional probability at one Ising site.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the conditional probability at one Ising site affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines UpProbability, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the conditional probability at one Ising site in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy Ising-site conditional uses inverse temperature Beta 0.4, coupling J 1, neighbor-spin sum 4, and external Field 0. What is P(spin=+1)?
